subject: explorable-load
note: the patched client against this world, two portal crossings in 28 s: into 146 Lakeside County with is_explorable 1, which cost 4984 client ticks (7.0 s) from its spawn request to its players request, and back into 148 Ascalon City, which cost 640 (0.90 s). The world tick stream is silent for 562 ticks after the spawn point and then arrives in one batch of six: the client is inside its loading screen. Server side of the same two travels: 5138 ms and 849 ms (logs/world-8001.log, not committed). See docs/23-initialization-protocol.md, The explorable.
